text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Amoxicillin-induced morbilliform drug eruption with associated arthralgia. The timeline of rash onset after one week of amoxicillin therapy, combined with the characteristic distribution (antecubital/popliteal fossae) and systemic symptoms (fever, joint pain), strongly suggests a hypersensitivity reaction rather than an infection like rheumatic fever or Kawasaki disease.
